name: MLPerf v5.1 Supermicro AS-4126GS-NBR-LCC 8x B200-SXM-180GB llama3.1-8b Interactive run_1 harness summary log
notes: THE UNITS PROOF. The v5.1 summary_results.json publishes this run as llama3.1-8b / Interactive / 122269.0 / Performance_Units='Queries/s'. The raw harness log for the identical run prints 'Completed samples per second : 947.90' and 'Completed tokens per second: 122268.73'. 122269 divided by 947.90 is 129.0 - the token count per sample - so the figure is tokens per second and the published unit label 'Queries/s' is simply wrong. Every one of the eight v5.1 llama3.1-8b Interactive rows carrying 'Queries/s' has this defect. This is the cleanest available demonstration that a number copied out of an MLPerf leaderboard can carry a unit that changes its meaning by a factor of ~129, with no error message anywhere.
